product: The Genie One Chrome extension is in Beta
tagline: The Genie One Chrome extension is now available in Beta.
what_it_does: The Genie One Chrome extension is now available in Beta. The extension makes every new Chrome tab open Genie One in your workspace, so asking a question, searching across your tools, or opening a dashboard takes one click. Install it from the Chrome Web Store.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
